title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Money Laundering

articles.content_en: Article 1: Where a person, for the purpose of concealing or disguising the source and nature of the proceeds and the proceeds generated therefrom derived from the commission of any predicate offense as prescribed in Article 191 of the Criminal Law by himself, commits any money laundering act as prescribed in the first paragraph of that Article, such person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 191 of the Criminal Law.

Article 2: Where a person who knows or should have known that the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom are derived from any predicate offense as prescribed in Article 191 of the Criminal Law committed by another person, for the purpose of concealing or disguising the source and nature thereof, commits any money laundering act as prescribed in the first paragraph of that Article, such person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 191 of the Criminal Law.

Article 3: The determination of "knowing or should have known" shall be made based on a comprehensive review and judgment of the information that the actor has come into contact with or received, the circumstances of handling the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom derived from another person's crime, the type and amount of the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom, the method of transfer or conversion of such proceeds and proceeds, the abnormal circumstances of the transaction behavior, capital accounts, etc., in combination with the actor's professional experience, the relationship with the person who committed the predicate offense, the actor's statements and defenses, the testimony of accomplices and witnesses, and other circumstances. Provided that there is evidence that the actor genuinely did not know, such actor shall be excluded.
Regarding the determination of "knowing or should have known", it shall not be affected if the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom derived from a certain predicate offense provided for in Article 191 of the Criminal Law are regarded as those derived from another predicate offense within the scope of the same Article.

Article 6: Where an act of concealing or disguising the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom derived from any predicate offense as prescribed in Article 191 of the Criminal Law constitutes the crime of money laundering as prescribed in Article 191 of the Criminal Law, and also constitutes the crime of concealing or disguising criminal proceeds and proceeds generated from crime as prescribed in Article 312 of the Criminal Law, such person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 191 of the Criminal Law.
Where an act of money laundering as prescribed in Article 191 of the Criminal Law constitutes the crime of money laundering, and also constitutes the crimes prescribed in Articles 349, 225, 177(a) or 120(a) of the Criminal Law, such person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions that provide for a heavier punishment.

Article 8: The term "proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom derived from mafia-type organized crimes" as provided in Article 191 of the Criminal Law refers to the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom derived from relevant crimes committed by a mafia-type organization and its members, including all property, pecuniary interests, and the fruits and proceeds thereof that have been amassed by the organization and its members through illegal and criminal activities during the formation and development of the mafia-type organization.

Article 9: Where a person is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention for committing the crime of money laundering, and a fine is imposed concurrently or solely, the fine shall be not less than 10,000 yuan; where a person is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan shall be imposed concurrently.

Article 10: Where a person who meets the conditions provided in Articles 1 and 2 of this Interpretation truthfully confesses the criminal facts, expresses remorse, and actively cooperates in the recovery of the proceeds and proceeds generated therefrom, such person may be given a lighter punishment; where the circumstances of the crime are minor, the person may not be prosecuted or may be exempted from criminal punishment according to law.

Article 11: Where a unit commits the crime of money laundering, the unit shall be fined in accordance with the conviction and sentencing standards for natural persons committing the corresponding crime as provided in this Interpretation, and the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be convicted and punished.

Article 12: The term "predicate offense" as used in this Interpretation refers to drug-related crimes, mafia-type organized crimes, terrorism-related crimes, smuggling crimes, crimes of embezzlement and bribery, crimes of disrupting the order of financial management, and financial fraud crimes as prescribed in Article 191 of the Criminal Law.

Article 13: This Interpretation shall come into force as of August 20, 2024. The Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Money Laundering and Other Criminal Cases (Fa Shi [2009] No. 15) shall be abolished simultaneously.
